_comment: Bootstrap model set. pick=default: approved and fetched by scripts/fetch-models.sh with no flags. pick=fallback / step-up: optional, only fetched with --fallback / --step-up. pick=language / language-small: interpreter for LANGUAGE_MODE=interpret (opt-in), only fetched with --language / --language-small; never by default. pick=locale-<lang>: language-native general model for LANGUAGE_MODE=swap, only fetched with --locale <lang>. The default LANGUAGE_MODE=native needs no extra model. role = models/<role>/ directory; scripts/serve.sh pins each role to the first installed entry of that role (manifest order) in the effective preset, so other files there are never served; dir = other directory (models-optional/...). revision = Hugging Face commit the file is downloaded from (resolve/<revision>/<file>); sha256 = Hugging Face LFS oid, checked before the file is moved into place. tested = verified end to end through scripts/serve.sh on llama.cpp b11374 (x86_64 CPU). notice = license notice printed by fetch-models.sh when the file is downloaded or restored.

optional, for 8 GB+ devices: tested once, 5.8 GB peak RSS at 16k ctx on x86 (incl. ~2.6 GB AMX repack copy)

candidates.note: Opt-in interpreter for LANGUAGE_MODE=interpret only; never fetched by default. Best round trip on the 8-item test (chrF 78.8 to English / 80.7 from English, 0 wrong-language outputs, 93/95 code spans kept), 23 tok/s. For Japanese agent tasks it was slower and less reliable than native mode (README Languages).
